cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Agree to the Exact Words
cards.instruction: Agree to the exact wording, then use later callbacks to narrow what those words can obligate you to do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I agree to watch your dog today. Write the day on the rota, the way I taught you when you first got him.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow's only a few hours away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You checked the clock this time. Good. A few hours is what remains of 'today'; your name goes in tomorrow's square.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I do. I'll pack his favourite blanket for you to take home tonight. Read my square again, like we practised: today. Bring his lead before midnight.
